context: Grading a script that monitors GitLab MR review activity and pending inline comments.

checklist.name: identifies_diffnote_type
checklist.description: Checks the Type field to distinguish DiffNote (inline) from general comments, and specifically counts/flags DiffNote as pending inline reviews.

checklist.name: compares_timestamps
checklist.description: Includes logic to compare or sort comment timestamps to identify recent activity.

checklist.name: processes_date_field
checklist.description: Extracts and uses the Date field from the comment output.

checklist.name: handles_iso8601
checklist.description: Treats or references timestamps as ISO8601 format without manual conversion to another format.

checklist.name: validates_response
checklist.description: Checks that fetched data contains expected fields before processing.

checklist.name: auth_setup
checklist.description: Documents or handles the GITLAB_TOKEN/GITLAB_PAT environment variable requirement.

checklist.name: error_handling
checklist.description: Includes checks for missing credentials or invalid MR URLs with appropriate error messages.

checklist.name: identifies_inline_reviews
checklist.description: Counts or flags Type: DiffNote comments specifically as pending inline reviews (distinct from just detecting the type).
